Scenarios.Scenario: GET /api/reference/offers against the configured tracker returns the offers visible to the API key.
Keitaro 4xx/5xx surfaces as HTTP 502 with the Keitaro error text; 404 surfaces as 404.
Cache invalidation lives in KeitaroClient.create_campaign / delete_campaign and bumps a per-key generation, so a list load that started before the invalidation is not stored.
Repeated GET /api/campaigns within the TTL is served from cache: live 2026-11-18 first call 4.0 s (Keitaro), next calls 2-4 ms; a campaign created by the tool appears immediately (cache invalidated).
GET /offers/{id}: 200 returns the offer, 403 (no read permission) returns None, 404 raises NotFoundError.

TraceAssertions.TraceAssertion: Every Keitaro request logs failures with the [Keitaro][request][BLOCK_REQUEST] prefix.

Scenarios.Scenario: POST /api/campaigns {name, country: de, offer_id} creates a position campaign with the default domain/group/source, stream #1 forced + country accept DE + redirect https://www.google.com, stream #2 regular landings with the offer at share 100, and returns the campaign URL.
If stream creation fails the campaign is deleted in Keitaro and the error is returned.
With CAMPAIGN_NAME_PREFIX=test_ponomaryov_, name campaign1 becomes test_ponomaryov_campaign1 and test_ponomaryov_campaign1 stays unchanged.

TraceAssertions.TraceAssertion: Live evidence 2026-11-18: campaign 214527 created with streams 1322714 (forced, country=DE, google) and 1322715 (landings, offer 18813 @ 100).

Scenarios.Scenario: Add offers in a draft: 100 -> 34/33/33, stream dirty, Keitaro unchanged until Push.
Add a 4th offer -> 25/25/25/25; Cancel restores 34/33/33 and deletes the draft-added offer from the wrapper.
Pin one offer at 25 and remove another -> pinned 25, the two unpinned active 38/37, removed offer grey with share 0; bring back -> 25/25/25/25.
Push sends only active offers; removed offers vanish from Keitaro but stay removed in the wrapper; one offer_changes row per push.
An offer deleted directly in Keitaro becomes removed after Fetch Streams; a pinned offer keeps its pin with the share Keitaro reports.
Push with active shares not summing to 100 (all pinned, sum 80), Push with zero active offers, and pinning above 100 in total are rejected with 422.

Draft edit, then an offer change made directly in Keitaro, then Push returns 409 conflict and Keitaro keeps the external change; Cancel + Fetch Streams + redo + Push succeeds (live 2026-11-18, campaign 214545 stream 1322770).

Draft actions, Push, Cancel and Fetch Streams are serialised by SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on the stream rows (populate_existing), so shares never mix two writers; the UI also disables row actions while Fetch Streams is running. Push holds the lock across its Keitaro calls (up to the HTTP timeout).

Fetch Streams stores arbitrarily long stream names and action payloads (Text columns, migration 0003) and clears a draft flag on streams whose schema is no longer landings; Cancel works for any schema.

TraceAssertions.TraceAssertion: rebalance keeps pinned shares and splits 100 minus the pinned sum equally among unpinned active offers (review obligation; tests are banned).
Live evidence 2026-11-18 on campaign 214554 (test_ponomaryov_editor_check, stream 1322796): all scenarios above observed against Keitaro GET /streams/1322796.
Draft, push and cancel actions log with [Editor][action][BLOCK_REBALANCE|BLOCK_PUSH] prefixes.
